claim: A Fishing Dock stops at 72 Meat: its stock reached 72 and the dock showed "No more storage space" with three fishers assigned. This matches the stored pile capacity of 72.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commits 95534692 and f272b4b5), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entry "Fishing Dock — observed storage stop at 72 Meat". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/fishing/dock-full-count.jpg and dock-full-status.jpg.

notes: Evergreen sandbox, day 41; Joshua, Violet and Nancy assigned, nothing taking Meat away until after the observation. The agent also found that a lone fisher moves to the first fishing position after the first worker is removed, so removing workers does not isolate the other positions.
